subject: curved lunar dust terraces
art_direction: 奶灰色月尘台地弯向远处，边缘被极低的金色光慢慢照亮。
visible_description: 奶灰色月尘台地弯向远处，边缘被极低的金色光慢慢照亮。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Study a series of smooth lunar dust terraces bending from the bottom right toward a distant low ridge. Very low golden sunlight catches each lip, while cool gray shadows remain broad and clean. Add a few tiny stones only near the foreground for scale. Let the terrain read as elegant sculpted geometry beneath a quiet blue-black sky. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
